{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the cleaned data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99'
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Compute conversion rates by channel and customer_segment
conversion_by_group = sales_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Extract the rates and compute differences
email_loyal = conversion_by_group.loc['email', 'loyal']
paid_search_loyal = conversion_by_group.loc['paid_search', 'loyal']
email_returning = conversion_by_group.loc['email', 'returning']
paid_search_returning = conversion_by_group.loc['paid_search', 'returning']
email_new = conversion_by_group.loc['email', 'new']
paid_search_new = conversion_by_group.loc['paid_search', 'new']

# Compute within-segment differences
diff_loyal = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal
diff_returning = email_returning - paid_search_returning
diff_new = email_new - paid_search_new

# Get segment counts by channel
segment_counts = sales_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Total counts per segment
segment_totals = segment_counts.sum(axis=0)

# Weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (diff_loyal * segment_totals['loyal'] + 
                 diff_returning * segment_totals['returning'] + 
                 diff_new * segment_totals['new']) / segment_totals.sum()

# Print all required values explicitly
print(f"Email conversion rate (loyal): {email_loyal:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate (loyal): {paid_search_loyal:.4f}")
print(f"Email conversion rate (returning): {email_returning:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate (returning): {paid_search_returning:.4f}")
print(f"Email conversion rate (new): {email_new:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate (new): {paid_search_new:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search) in loyal: {diff_loyal:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search) in returning: {diff_returning:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search) in new: {diff_new:.4f}")
print(f"Weighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff:.4f}")"}
